node.label: Epiphyseal stippling of toe phalanges
node.definition: The presence of abnormal punctate (speckled, dot-like) calcifications in the epiphyses of phalanges of the toes.

evidence.snippet: Brachytelephalangic chondrodysplasia punctata: Epiphyseal stippling of toe phalanges (frequency HP:0040283) [TAS]
Epiphyseal stippling of toe phalanges — Occasional (29-5%)
